newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Heat employees launch strike.
newsitem.headline: Thai Heat employees launch strike.

text.p: Thai Heat Exchange said about 100 employees of Thai Heat Exchange Plc launched a strike on Thursday but operations were not disrupted.

The company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the striking employees, most of them unskilled workers, walked out of their jobs and gathered in front of the company's headquareters.
It said supervisors and skilled employees were working normally and the company had also employed some daily employees as a substitution for the striking workers.
The strike was launched after talks between with management on Tuesday over an amendment of the workers' employeement status ended in a deadlock.
Thai Heat Exchange, a manufacturer of air conditioners, was trading at 3.50 baht at 0758 GMT on Thursday, unchanged from Wednesday.
